checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eyes appear light amber/yellow, which contrasts significantly with the deep red/rust coat color. Rhodesian Ridgeback eyes typically match the coat color (dark brown/amber), not this pale shade.

While the coat color and general body type are plausible, the facial features strongly suggest a different breed (e.g., Vizsla) or a mix, resulting in poor class conformance.
